edits.find:
- name: Install package + test deps
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .
          pip install --require-hashes -r tests/requirements.txt
      - name: No change may turn a REJECT into an ALLOW
edits.replace:
- name: Install package + test deps
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .
          pip install --require-hashes -r tests/requirements.txt
      # This job runs the SAME suite as `test`, so it needs the same binaries. Adding
      # them to `test` alone left this job failing on `FileNotFoundError: 'ruff'` --
      # the identical defect, one job over, found only by reading CI again.
      - name: Install shellcheck
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y shellcheck
      - name: Install ruff
        run: pip install ruff
      - name: No change may turn a REJECT into an ALLOW
